source: Plugins are self-contained code that usually add app-level functionality to Vue. In Nuxt, plugins are automatically imported from the {0} directory. However, if you need to ship a plugin with your module, Nuxt Kit provides the {1} and {2} methods. These utils allow you to customize the plugin configuration to better suit your needs.
